AN OVERVIEW
Despite a challenging business environment, Gestetner of Ceylon PLC Group turnover increased 11% to Rs.
1,947.4 million, while profit after tax reached Rs. 103 million, driven by the Company's focus on its core
businesses and strong partnerships with customers, suppliers and business partners.
A defining milestone of the year was the acquisition of a controlling interest of total 54.79% in the Company
by SiS International Holdings Limited, through its subsidiary World Elite Limited in late 2025.
The Board is confident that this new ownership structure will create meaningful opportunities to strengthen
the Company's existing operations while opening the door to new products, technologies, brands and
business opportunities.

The Board and Management remain focused on
translating these opportunities into sustainable growth
